title: Hill-climbed producers for a conditional κ = 4.105106623e-5 bound
body:
Under the inherited analytic and fixed finite-alphabet multitape hypotheses,

$$T(n)=O(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}),\qquad \kappa=\frac{4105106623}{10^{14}}=4.105106623\times10^{-5}>2^{-15}.$$

This conditional exponent saving is approximately **0.10918% above #46** (`82012589/(2*10^12)`). The bit saving is `4105275149/10^14`. These compare asymptotic bounds, not practical running times.

### Construction

Pinned adjacent-swap vectors change the summand orders in RaD's total computations. The selected graphs and carrier matchings reduce the local role counts from 36,685 to **36,656** at h23 and from 48,479 to **48,398** at h25: 110 fewer local roles in total. After replication, width W falls from 178,378,409 to **178,168,258**.

The original-envelope labels, both fixed I+J bases, copied centers, every paid endpoint correction, reversed data corners with exact recovery of all ten fallbacks, complex layer and balanced assembly are retained from #46. Complete local profiles and accounting are recomputed for the changed graphs and pinned links.

### Validation and scope

**Full `make verify` PASSED** at research commit `bbd2d88fec0485ed5715d994c9cde6a8ac1d3d3a`: **191 tests**, all five new focused tests, fresh hill-climbed producer/profile replay and independent physical timeline/dirty-basis checks in both dimensions, full inherited 4,073,300-pair data geometry with exact fallback recovery, and **18 historical patch checks**. Completed 2026-10-08T15:05:13.167818+00:00; log SHA256 `13925a77be211a5d413732d576bee30c703837966d81475819840c14d29ae721`. [Validation receipt](https://github.com/rohanarun/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/climbed-producers/research/climbed-producers/validation.json). Follow-up changes are documentation and receipt metadata only.

The optimizer uses floating-point logarithmic weights and SciPy assignment for a first-order objective. The exact certificate validates the selected pinned construction; it does not certify an exact matching optimum. The updated research README distinguishes the numerical search procedure from the exact certificate for its pinned output. The greedy graph search likewise makes no global optimality claim. All inherited analytic and fixed-tape proof obligations remain, and passing finite checks is not formal verification or external expert acceptance of the whole theorem.

```sh
make climbed-producers-verify
make verify
```

Python 3.11+ and a C++ compiler are required. On Linux/GCC the handoff recommends `make verify CXX="c++ -include algorithm"`. The certificate replay uses pinned links and does not require rerunning the SciPy search.

The increment sits on #46 at `71b6c960c89295e952522dd44111df9cfc51ae90`. See `research/climbed-producers/README.md`, its source manifest, pinned swap vectors, links, profiles and exact certificate.
